name: northlane-supabase-blueprint
description: Working blueprint for moving the North Lane CRM from SQLite to Supabase: schema, RLS, money rules, phone bridge, email, SMS, public signing, PWA. With tests.

scripts.test: npm run db:reset && npm run test:db && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: node -e "const v=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if(v[0]<22||(v[0]===22&&v[1]<23)) {console.error('Node 22.23.4 or newer');process.exit(1)}" && npm test
